Messages.Author: Karl Innes
Messages.Body:
Just wondering about this... Since you can prevent damage in any
order you wish, How exactly does burning wrath work??

Is the entire damage aggravated, or only the +2 portion that
burning wrath adds???

Thanks, Karl

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Karl Innes <in...@infomatch.com> writes:




Officialy, only the 2 additional points are aggravated by Burning Wrath.

By card text, all of Burning Wrath's damage is aggravated (standard
grammar rules regarding commas).

Treat the official "ruling" as errata.
